```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: "stable"

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: "stable"
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          dart pub get
          flutter pub get

      - name: Verify version consistency
        run: |
          dart run tool/version_check.dart

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          dart test
          flutter test

      - name: Run code analysis
        run: |
          dart analyze
          flutter analyze

      - name: Run security checks
        run: |
          dart pub deps --style=tree
          flutter pub deps --style=tree

      - name: Check for version.g.dart changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || (echo "Error: version.g.dart file has changed. Please run the version check script locally and commit the changes." && exit 1)

  publish:
    needs: ci
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: "stable"

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: "stable"
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          dart test
          flutter test

      - name: Run code analysis
        run: |
          dart analyze
          flutter analyze

      - name: Publish packages
        run: |
          dart pub publish --dry-run
          flutter pub publish --dry-run
```
